item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 3 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 3 #NCR_PRSD
Issued at: 7:23 PM, 09 November 2026(Monday)

Moderate to heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over Laguna (Calauan, Nagcarlan, Alaminos, San Pablo, Rizal, Liliw, Majayjay, Luisiana, Magdalena, Pagsanjan, Cavinti, Paete, Pakil, Pangil, Famy, Siniloan, Mabitac, Kalayaan, Lumban, and Santa Maria) and Quezon (Perez, Mauban, Real, Infanta, Candelaria, Dolores, Tiaong, Sampaloc, Lucban, Sariaya, Tayabas, Alabat, Polillo, Panukulan, Burdeos, Atimonan, Lucena, and Pagbilao) within the next 2 hours.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.

item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 4 #NCRPRSD
item.description:

Light to moderate rains affecting Quezon(Alabat, Quezon, Polillo, Panukulan, Real, Atimonan, Mauban, Padre Burgos, Pagbilao, Perez), Laguna(Siniloan, Famy, Mabitac, Pangil, Pakil, Paete, Kalayaan, Lumban), Cavite(Tagaytay) and Batangas(Talisay, Tanauan) and may affect nearby areas.

For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to www.pagasa.dost.gov.ph.
